delta: Project Owner explicitly removed any exact five-line, minimum-line, or maximum-line requirement for user-facing summaries. The original purpose of the summary rule was to preserve an easy-to-scan owner-facing recap, not to force compression or a fixed shape. Substantive answers should normally include a useful summary when it helps, but it may be longer, shorter, or omitted when redundant. UNDERSTANDING_BEFORE_COMPRESSION and no-unexplained-jargon rules remain mandatory and take precedence over brevity or formatting.
